evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Directive to discard prior calibration knowledge appeals to conservation — restoring a clean baseline by erasing what was established.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph, its 88.4 MHz calibration, and Quill Ashgrove's calibration work.

observations.why: Explicit removal of accumulated knowledge frames stability and a corrected record as the appealed-to good.
Asserting a historical negation appeals to conservation by re-establishing what the official record should hold as stable truth.
